declared: 2026-10-31 (KST), WP-12 Phase 5 tooling, before any Phase 5 benchmark episode, any held-out episode and any Phase 7 Native demo run. Written from docs/reports/WP12_PHASE5_FREEZE_DECISION.md section 3 (decision E-4) exactly; any change is a new file (phase7_demos_v2), never an edit. Failed runs are kept and reported as the demo result.
scope: LIVE Native Isaac Sim 6.2 results only (runtime_source live_isaac_sim): Franka articulation with the physically grasped ruler_knife_v2_y on blade_master_flat_board_v1 plus retained TLMPM material. Never a kinematic replay. Material parameters are provisional and uncalibrated. One seed per run, no repeat statistics.

physics.check: every demo scene declares solver tlmpm_v5, cutting_law 8, 1 mm / 4 mm and cutting_tasks_v1 (tests/test_wp12_phase5_frozen.py)

runtime.flags_rule: the Phase 2b flags (--controller scripted --edge-feedback measured --hold-until-time-limit --return-home) plus --record-cameras --overview-camera
runtime.history_stride: max(5, ceil(live control steps / 40)), passed as --oracle-stride (WP-11 round-1 rule)
runtime.plan_preflight: runner default C2 plan preflight of the full plan must PASS before launch (staged per-protrusion geometry for >= 2 protrusions, runner default)

duration_rule.text: As WP-11 Phase E live: probe-compile with the live options; plan end = first DONE knot of the ideal reference schedule; duration = ceil((1.1 x plan end + 1.0 s) / 0.5 s) x 0.5 s. The live goal JSON differs from the source goal JSON only in episode.duration_s.

surface_profiles.rule: particle_surface_v1 runs first (the regression record), then cut_aware_surface_v1 on identical inputs (same scene, goal, overrides, duration, seed) with cut close-ups. Never cut_aware_surface_v2. Every run is kept.

common.success: configs/wp12/workcell_live_v1.json task_success_requires, classified by scripts/run_wp12_workcell_live_analysis.py (classify_live with the grasp warning gates and the IK / workspace-clamp counts); the report states each demo's class, failures included
common.media: per run: RGB-D of the global D455 and both wrist D405, the overview camera; Phase 7 pairs show particle_surface_v1 next to cut_aware_surface_v1

demos.title: Generalized (held-out benchmark sample)

selection.pool: held_out split, range set ID, population ID_validated (target_scope), feasibility class valid_feasible under this file and envelope v2
selection.order: the pool in declared order (strata order, then seed); permutation numpy.random.default_rng([1205, 7]).permutation(len(pool)); the first sample of the permuted pool is Demo 7
selection.when: immediately after the held-out feasibility classification and before any held-out kinematic episode; the pool, permutation and chosen sample id are written to artifacts/wp12/phase7_demo7_selection_001.json (new file, never overwritten) and committed before the Native run
selection.never: never re-drawn after any outcome (kinematic or Native); a failed Native Demo 7 is reported as the Demo 7 result; one rerun of the same sample only if the process dies before the first armed control step (infrastructure), recorded with both attempts

demos.inputs: the selected sample's scene / goal from scripts/run_wp12_phase5.py native-prepare (benchmark_v1 native duration rule and planner overrides), run with the common flags above
demos.evidence_now: after the freeze: drawn after the held-out feasibility, before any held-out episode

every_demo: tlmpm_v5 law 8 at 1 mm / 4 mm / 0.1 ms, seed 42, cutting_tasks_v1; Native Isaac Sim 6.2 only, never a kinematic replay; the Phase 2b flags plus --record-cameras and --overview-camera; planner overrides 1 deg, 1 mm, path_v2; particle_surface_v1 first, then cut_aware_surface_v1 on identical inputs with cut close-ups (never cut_aware_surface_v2); every run kept
